products.title: The lab.
products.lead: Every tool starts from a real problem seen on the court. First we watch how the people who coach actually work: how many hours a report costs, where exactly the time goes, what you need in your hands on Monday morning. Then we look in the scientific literature for what holds up against real data, we turn it into a model and into software, and we put it in the hands of working coaches. One rule holds it all together: if it isn't useful on Monday morning, we don't use it.

team.title:
Few people,
highly specialised.
team.p1: We're a group of sport professionals, physicists and designers working at the same table. It isn't a matter of style but of necessity: turning scientific literature into a genuinely useful tool. That requires the person who knows the model, the one who writes the code and the one who designs the interface to talk every day, with no handovers between departments that never meet.
team.p2: None of us comes only from theory, and none only from product. The people on the scientific side have watched real sessions and know the constraints of a season: the space that isn't there, the data nobody has time to collect, the decisions that have to be made anyway. The people building the software learned to read a report before designing one. Around the group are the working coaches testing TrainMind — they are the real added value of the project, and they are the ones who tell us what is actually needed.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body:
This notice explains how [RAGIONE SOCIALE] (“LAB21”, “we”) handles the personal data of people who visit this website, under Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (“GDPR”) and Italian Legislative Decree 196/2003.

It covers the showcase website only. If you use the TrainMind platform, the handling of your account data, training records and health data is described in the separate TrainMind privacy policy.

1. Data controller

[RAGIONE SOCIALE], [SEDE LEGALE] — VAT 00000000000. For any request concerning personal data, write to info@lab21.it.

2. What we collect

This site has no contact forms, requires no registration and uses no analytics or profiling tools. The only data processed are:

  • Server technical logs: IP address, date and time of the request, page requested, browser and operating system. Any web server generates these automatically; they keep the site running and protect it from abuse.
  • Language preference: the language you pick is stored in your browser (localStorage) so it is still there on your next visit. It never leaves your device and is never sent to us.
  • Correspondence: if you email the address above, we process what your message contains in order to reply.

3. Why we process it, and on what legal basis

PurposeLegal basis
Running the site and keeping it secureLegitimate interest — Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR
Remembering your language choiceTechnical necessity — Art. 122 D.lgs. 196/2003
Replying to people who write to usLegitimate interest / response to a request — Art. 6(1)(f)/(b)

4. No tracking

We do not use Google Analytics or anything equivalent, we install no advertising pixels, we build no user profiles and we run no behavioural advertising. That is also why there is no cookie banner: nothing here requires your consent (see the cookie policy).

5. Who we share data with

  • Hosting provider ([HOSTING PROVIDER]), which hosts the site and stores the technical logs as a data processor.
  • Google Fonts: typefaces are loaded from Google’s servers, which receive your IP address at that moment. If you would rather avoid it, you can block requests to fonts.googleapis.com in your browser settings or extensions.

We do not sell, rent or trade personal data with third parties for commercial purposes.

6. How long we keep it

  • Server technical logs: up to 12 months.
  • Language preference: until you clear your browser data.
  • Email correspondence: for as long as needed to handle your request and, if a relationship follows, as required by applicable law.

7. Transfers outside the European Union

The site is hosted on servers within the European Union. The only potentially non-EU flow is the one to Google for loading fonts, covered by the safeguards under Arts. 44 ff. GDPR (EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework adequacy decision and standard contractual clauses).

8. Your rights

At any time you can ask us for access to your data, rectification, erasure, restriction or portability, and you can object to processing based on legitimate interest (Arts. 15–22 GDPR). Write to info@lab21.it: we reply within one month.

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Italian supervisory authority, Garante per la protezione dei dati personali (garanteprivacy.it), or with the authority of the country where you live.

9. Changes

If the tools used by the site change, we update this notice and the date at the top of the page.
cookie.title: Cookie policy
cookie.body:
This page explains which cookies and similar technologies the LAB21 website uses, under Art. 122 of Italian Legislative Decree 196/2003 and the Italian data protection authority’s cookie guidelines of 10 June 2021.

In short

This site uses one piece of technical storage only: the one that remembers the language you chose. There are no analytics or profiling cookies, so we do not need to ask for your consent and you will not see a banner.

1. What they are

Cookies are small files a website stores on your device. Similar technologies such as localStorage do the same job: keeping a piece of information between visits. We call them all “cookies” here.

2. What this site uses

NameTypePurposeDuration
lab21.lang Technical (localStorage) Remembers the language you chose (IT / EN / ES) so you do not have to pick it again. Until you clear your browser data

That is all. No analytics, profiling, advertising or social network cookies.

3. Why there is no cookie banner

Consent is required only for non-technical cookies. Since this site uses exactly one technical item, strictly necessary to deliver a service you asked for (seeing the site in your chosen language), this notice is sufficient.

4. Third-party content

The site loads its typefaces from Google Fonts. Google sets no cookies for this, but it does receive your IP address when the font is downloaded. You can prevent this by blocking requests to fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com in your browser.

5. How to delete stored data

You can delete cookies and localStorage at any time from your browser settings (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge: “Privacy and security” → “Clear browsing data”). The only thing you lose is the stored language: the site goes back to showing English.

6. TrainMind

The TrainMind platform is a separate application with its own cookie policy and a consent banner, because it may use statistical and marketing tools.

7. Contact

Questions about this page: info@lab21.it. Controller: [RAGIONE SOCIALE], [SEDE LEGALE].
